versions.changelog:
- Added _meta.json file to the project.
- No other changes to the skill functionality or documentation.

Initial release of mediaio-google-veo-video-generator.

- Generate cinematic-quality AI videos from text or image using Google Veo (Veo 3 / Veo 3.1) via Media.io OpenAPI.
- Includes support for Credits, Task Result, Google Veo 3.1, and Google Veo 3.1 Fast APIs.
- Requires a Media.io OpenAPI key set in the API_KEY environment variable.
- Poll video generation status using Task Result with the returned task_id.
- See documentation for example usage and API details.
